text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Cla-chan♪ We're gonna 
celebrate to the fullest today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch! Thanks a bunch! I'm 
looking forward to it, Dia♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, I guess this year's "big sister 
period" is over now, huh~~...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as for the "Big Sister Period," you 
see!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You mean the time between Dia's birthday 
and my birthday... right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's that time of year when Dia somehow 
feels like doting on me even more than 
usual♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, every year around this time, Dia 
invites me to do all sorts of things. It's 
so cute~♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Maaan, and here I wanted to return the 
favor since you're always helping me out 
like a big sis~...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, don't pout, don't pout! I'm looking 
forward to next year too, so act like my 
'big sister' again, okay? Pretty please?
